script_text: Seven, eleven, twenty-one keep finding you — on clocks, receipts, license plates — and the universe is not being playful. Lucky Numbers is a Mercury-ruled, Air-element signature: repeating numerical patterns your mind is being trained to notice. This week Mercury at 24° Sagittarius trines Jupiter in Leo, the luckiest alignment of the year. Jupiter sits in your 10th House, so a contract, raise, or lottery ticket lands after November 20. Meanwhile Venus in Scorpio opens your 7th House, and a former lover texts at midnight. But Saturn in Pisces squares that Mercury, and Chiron in your 1st House wounds you when you gamble for escape; the North Node in Virgo says heal, not chase. Survival tip: bet one dollar, write the numbers down, then walk away and breathe. Comment your sign below, and I will map your personal lucky window before December.
